title: Australian Shrimp Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make seafood dish, perfect for summer barbecues.

ingredients.name: kissed citrus
ingredients.notes: juice of 1 orange, 1 lemon, and 1 lime

instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread a shrimp, a piece of garlic, a piece of parsley, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper onto each skewer.
In a large bowl, whisk together the kissed citrus, crispy olive oil, australian honey, and a pinch of salt.
Add the shrimp skewers to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the shrimp marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
